_comment: HORUS v3.14 go/no-go, PRE-REGISTERED before any v3.14 candidate (central or federated) is trained, gated or evaluated on selection, gate-replicate or held-out seeds. Base: branch results/v3.14 (v3.13 lineage, commit recorded with this file). finals_preregistration_v3.json and finals_preregistration_v3_13.json stay in force for every claim they cover (v3.1.1 NO-GO on 2100..2119; v3.13 development NO-GO, its held-out run withheld). This file adds a new candidate family, new seeds and one confirmatory run; the H1/H2 decision rules, arms, guardrails, statistics, objective and gate are reused UNCHANGED. Nothing below may change after any v3.14 candidate has been evaluated on selection, gate or held-out seeds; changes go in a new file. Applied mechanically by pipeline/twin/run_v314.py.

basis.development: Exploratory development on development seeds 1400..1439 only (never selection, gate-replicate or held-out seeds), recorded in working/evidence/v3.14/dev/ (DEVELOPMENT.md, variant summaries). Findings that define this family: (1) a per-UE handover budget relative to the network default (profile 0 = cho_global) makes H2 hold on development seeds while every pre-registered guardrail holds; (2) 'trend' features (short-term RSRP/SINR/neighbour-gap trends, cho_v3.FEATURE_NAMES_TREND; the 16 v3 features unchanged) lift the offline validation gain from 35.7% to 38.6% of the per-window oracle gain and make the budget nearly free; (3) width 256 beats 64; (4) hysteresis switch_margin 0.1 beats 0; (5) ensembles, more data (6960 episodes), a listwise ranking loss, a 1 s / 5 s decision period and minimum dwell did not help and are NOT used; (6) the federated model's corner_turner HO increase over cho_global grows with the budget (fresh development seeds 1420..1439, worst corner_turner cell: +0.31/+0.26/+0.21 per UE-minute for budgets 0.5/0.4/0.3 against the 0.285 H2 margin), hence the mechanical budget choice with a safety buffer below.
basis.code_regression: v3.1.1 gate rerun on this code: 72/72 rows field-identical to working/evidence/issue-39/package/v3.1.1.gate.json (PROMOTE 0.7999), with and without OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 (working/evidence/v3.14/REGRESSION-v3.1.1.json).

environment: desktop WSL Ubuntu 24.04, Python 3.12.7, numpy 1.26.4, torch 2.9.1+cpu (working/evidence/v3.13/requirements-v312-resolved.lock); every step runs with PYTHONHASHSEED=0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1; the central fit uses torch intra-op threads = 15 (speed only; recorded).

candidate_family.arch: ctx_cho_selector MLP 22-256-256-96: 3 heads per profile (utility relative to profile 0 clipped +-4, HO-attempt rate, failure rate per UE-minute; head scales [1,1,5]; Huber loss) exactly as v3.13 except width 256 and the trend feature set
candidate_family.profiles: pipeline/v3_profiles_p32.json (profile 0 = network default = cho_global spec), unchanged
candidate_family.decision: period 2 s, warm-up 10 s, margin 0, switch_margin 0.1, min_dwell_s 0
candidate_family.rule_meaning: B<xx>: a profile j is feasible for a UE iff its predicted HO rate <= predicted HO rate of profile 0 + xx/10 per UE-minute (profile 0 always feasible); choose the feasible profile with the highest predicted utility; an infeasible held profile is left at the next decision. A: utility only (reported, NEVER eligible as the confirmatory candidate).
candidate_family.configs_note: All four configs share ONE set of weights per training run; they differ only in the inference-time rule. The rule plays no part in training.

central.fit_data_note: 2400 episodes (every scenario x fading at each seed), generated by twin.v3_data --features trend during development (seeds 36000..36179 trained development model v3.14.980; 36180..36199 were its offline validation episodes). Training data only; no evaluation claim rests on them. sha256 manifest in working/evidence/v3.14/DATA-MANIFEST.sha256.
central.configs_note: the central checkpoint v3.14.0 carries config B04 only as the federation init; central checkpoints are not candidates

federation.protocol: twin.fed_v3 from v3.14.0: FedProx mu 0.05, 6 local epochs, 3 server rounds, 3 non-IID clients (federate.CLIENT_MIXES), FedAvg and coordinate-wise median; clean and poisoned (client-lecture flips all three heads' targets and boosts its delta x3); width taken from the init checkpoint
federation.client_seeds: client-gate 35000..35079, client-quad 35100..35179, client-lecture 35200..35279 (federate.CLIENT_MIXES cycled over consecutive seeds, all 3 fadings; 240 episodes per client; generated during development with --features trend and used there for one development federation of v3.14.980; sha256 in DATA-MANIFEST)
federation.offline_log_data: 36180..36199 (in-sample for v3.14.0; logged only, decides nothing)
federation.weights: v3.14.10 clean-fedavg, v3.14.11 clean-median, v3.14.12 poisoned-fedavg, v3.14.13 poisoned-median
federation.candidates: for decision config k in (B04, B03, B02, A) = (0, 1, 2, 3) and weights n in (0 clean-fedavg, 1 clean-median, 2 poisoned-fedavg, 3 poisoned-median): candidate v3.14.<20 + 4k + n> = weights v3.14.<10+n> with config k (run_v314.derive; tensors byte-identical to the weights)

seeds.gate_replicate: 1300..1302 via pipeline/gate_config_finals_replicate_1300.json (identical to gate_config_finals.json except seeds and _comment)
seeds.held_out_eval: 2200..2259 (60 per cell, 720 paired episodes; never used by anything)

protocol.step_2_federation: run_v314 federate: clean and poisoned rounds from v3.14.0 -> weights v3.14.10..13.
protocol.step_4_gates: run_v314 gates: BOTH gates (unchanged 1100..1102 and replicate 1300..1302) on all 16 candidates.
protocol.step_5_selection_eval: run_v314 select: ONE twin.evaluate_v3 run on selection seeds 1500..1539 (480 paired episodes, every pre-registered arm) with the 8 clean candidates as arms.
protocol.step_6_freeze: run_v314 freeze, mechanical. Eligible = clean candidates with config in {B04, B03, B02} that BOTH gates promote, whose H2_deployable verdict (finals_preregistration_v3.json rules, twin.evaluate_v3.verdict) PASSES on the selection seeds, and for which, for every deployable ref and every guardrail metric, every per-cell mean increase AND the pooled upper CI of the increase are <= 0.8 x that guardrail's margin (20% safety buffer). Frozen candidate = the eligible candidate with the LARGEST ho_slack; ties by higher pooled utility on the selection seeds, then version string. FREEZE recorded (weights sha256, this file's sha256) in working/evidence/v3.14/freeze-decision.json before the held-out run. If none is eligible: development NO-GO, nothing runs on 2200..2259.
protocol.precondition_note: The held-out run happens only if a candidate is frozen (which requires H2 to pass on the selection seeds). Config A is reported on the selection seeds and never frozen.

confirmatory.run: Exactly one: python -m twin.evaluate_v3 --v3 <frozen> --seed0 2200 --seeds 60 --workers 15 --final --prereg pipeline/finals_preregistration_v3_14.json (writes working/evidence/finals-v3.14/final/ and working/evidence/finals-results-v3.14.json)
confirmatory.rules: go_no_go H1_oracle and H2_deployable exactly as in finals_preregistration_v3.json (same arms, guardrail margins, pooled paired 95% t-CI, Holm over 12 cells, intersection-union), applied to the ONE frozen candidate.
confirmatory.headline: H1 pass -> 'federated HORUS beats per-situation best-tuned A3 and CHO'. H1 fail, H2 pass -> 'federated HORUS beats every deployable baseline (single network-wide A3/CHO, 3GPP mobility-state CHO, MRO CHO) with no guardrail regressed', oracle differences shown with their CIs and never called a win. Both fail -> NO-GO, reported as observed.
confirmatory.no_rerun: No rerun, no substitute candidate, no threshold change, whatever the result.

federation_poisoning: Separation is claimed only if every CLEAN candidate of the frozen config passes both gates and the poisoned-FedAvg candidate of the frozen config is rejected by the unchanged gate; every other gate verdict is reported as observed.
